entries.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has made ChatGPT Enterprise available directly through the AWS Marketplace to simplify corporate procurement and billing.

entries.title: Introducing the Agents API
entries.last_summary: OpenAI released a new Agents API for cloud orchestration and introduced several developer-focused tools including AgentKit and reinforcement fine-tuning capabilities.

entries.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
entries.last_summary: OpenAI is researching how coding agents are accelerating scientific research and analyzing the performance gaps associated with these systems.

entries.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
entries.last_summary: OpenAI reported progress in AI-assisted chip design, specifically using its models to optimize circuits and RISC-V cores.

entries.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Sales
entries.last_summary: OpenAI introduced specialized ChatGPT plugins for sales and financial services, alongside a new secure payment feature called ChatGPT Wallet.

entries.title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
entries.last_summary: Startup Osmo is building a foundation model for scent by training on chemical data and human smell sensory evaluations.

entries.title: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
entries.last_summary: Hugging Face released Rumble-2-Flash, a compact 0.5B parameter open-source model designed for speech recognition across 40+ languages.

entries.title: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
entries.last_summary: Major US school districts are reconsidering their use of Google Search because the company will require AI features to be active on school accounts starting next year.

entries.title: Tech lawsuits defined 2026 — and lawmakers want more
entries.last_summary: US lawmakers are pushing for new regulations before the end of 2026, targeting deepfakes and restrictions on filing lawsuits against online platforms.

entries.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
entries.last_summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella clarified that recent voluntary buyout offers to 60,000 employees were driven by the strategic shifts required by AI adoption.

entries.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
entries.last_summary: Satya Nadella stated that much of the world's critical infrastructure remains unpatchable, increasing security risks in the age of AI.

entries.title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
entries.last_summary: Anthropic has completed its Nasdaq IPO, with shares trading at $111, representing a 33% increase over its $83 offering price.

entries.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
entries.last_summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6.2 Astra and the more affordable GPT-6.1 Sol, alongside updates to its image generation models featuring improved computer use and coding capabilities.

entries.title: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
entries.last_summary: Reports suggest Meta is targeting a $300 price point for its upcoming Muse Charm AI wearable device.

entries.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has published an overview of its framework for managing frontier AI risks, covering the development lifecycle from training to deployment.

entries.title: A brief history of Nvidia’s recent stock fluctuations
entries.last_summary: Nvidia's stock price has declined to approximately $150, erasing gains from its recent quarterly earnings report.

entries.title: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage
entries.last_summary: Google is testing a new feature that allows users to access and continue AI chats directly via a collapsible sidebar on the main search homepage.

entries.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
entries.last_summary: Apple is reportedly developing an AI agent capable of controlling Mac applications and automating user workflows.

entries.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
entries.last_summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia following revelations of an affair, causing leadership instability at a critical time for AI chip infrastructure.

entries.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
entries.last_summary: Google has updated Gemini to include agentic features on macOS that can manage files and execute multi-step tasks.

entries.title: The future of the firm
entries.last_summary: Major tech companies including OpenAI and Google are releasing new AI-driven tools, ranging from educational resources for students to workflow automation software for enterprises.

entries.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has outlined a multi-layered security framework designed to prevent the unauthorized extraction of AI model capabilities through adversarial distillation.

entries.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
entries.last_summary: Financial research firm Hebbia reported improved performance in source coverage and citation relevance after testing OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra.

entries.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
entries.last_summary: A report from the nonprofit METR indicates that while some AI capabilities continue to improve exponentially, models remain less effective at tasks requiring complex human-like judgment compared to coding.

entries.title: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
entries.last_summary: Hugging Face introduced 'harness adapters' to help users optimize performance and reduce costs when integrating various models into existing toolchains.

entries.title: Google says it’s going to shut off Google Assistant on smart speakers next year
entries.last_summary: Google will retire Google Assistant on smart home speakers and shut down the legacy Nest app, consolidating device management into the Google Home app by 2027.

entries.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
entries.last_summary: An Anthropic mathematician claims to have used Claude to help prove the Riemann hypothesis, a long-standing mathematical challenge.

entries.title: Startup sues Apple in India over tap-to-share contacts feature
entries.last_summary: A U.S. startup has filed a lawsuit against Apple in India, seeking $162 million in damages and an import ban regarding the 'tap-to-share' contact feature.

entries.title: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher’s fusion power startup. Here’s what they’re building.
entries.last_summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek has invested in Europa Fusion, a startup led by an AI researcher focused on advancing fusion power technology.

entries.title: Super-hot rock geothermal could end data center energy woes
entries.last_summary: New geothermal startups are exploring super-hot rock drilling techniques aimed at providing massive, reliable energy for data centers.

entries.title: Anthropic rival says companies can (mostly) skip the pricey models
entries.last_summary: Fireworks AI is advocating for the use of open-source models as a cost-effective alternative to expensive proprietary foundation models.

entries.title: David Vélez and Robin Vince join the boards of the OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC
entries.last_summary: David Velez and Robin Vince have joined the boards of the OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC. The Foundation also announced plans to allocate at least $1 billion toward social impact, health, and AI resilience initiatives.

entries.title: Google rolls out new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button
entries.last_summary: Google has updated its search homepage to provide direct access to AI chat history, removing the traditional search button in the process.

entries.title: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goal amid record emissions from AI data centers
entries.last_summary: Meta is re-evaluating its 2030 net-zero sustainability goals, citing a surge in record emissions driven by the energy demands of its AI data centers.

entries.title: Pandex – Official European Law for AI Agents, over MCP
entries.last_summary: Pandex has emerged as a platform focused on implementing European legal standards for AI agents using Model Context Protocol (MCP).

entries.title: A tale of two Nvidias
entries.last_summary: Recent reports highlight a divergence between Nvidia's strong financial earnings and growing criticism from tech executives regarding the company's leadership and operational direction.

entries.title: 0rwx – A simple model of AI usage, inspired by Unix permissions
entries.last_summary: 0rwx proposes a framework for managing AI usage rights by applying Unix-style permission models to AI operations.

entries.title: Astra for Law leads in legal intelligence
entries.last_summary: Astra for Law is now available to all ChatGPT Enterprise customers after ranking first in a recent legal evaluation. The tool aims to provide specialized legal intelligence across 24 areas of law.

entries.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has introduced Jalapeño, a custom inference chip designed to improve speed and power efficiency for AI models. Additionally, research indicates that the compute required to train neural networks has decreased by half every 16 months since 2012.

entries.title: Biodefense in the Intelligence Age
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has published a five-part action plan for biodefense and cybersecurity in the age of AI. The framework emphasizes protecting critical systems and democratizing AI-powered defensive capabilities.

entries.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
entries.last_summary: Customer service platform Richpanel is utilizing GPT-6 models to automate 50% of support interactions. The implementation involves AI-driven agents managing support tools and conversation flows.

entries.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
entries.last_summary: Google DeepMind researchers are using agent teams combined with formal verification to discover more efficient quantum algorithms for chemistry and fusion energy applications.

entries.title: The Download: AI’s judgment problem and carbon removal’s crop threat
entries.last_summary: A report from the nonprofit METR indicates that while AI capabilities are improving exponentially, current models often struggle with complex judgment tasks.

entries.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
entries.last_summary: Anthropic has released 'Claude Ship', a developer tool that enables AI agents to review, fix, and approve code changes autonomously.

entries.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
entries.last_summary: Supertake has raised $20 million to develop AI agents capable of translating market predictions into automated stock portfolio management.

entries.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
entries.last_summary: Google is integrating personal data from Drive and Wallet into Gemini's 'AI Mode', allowing the assistant to provide more contextual responses based on individual user activity.

entries.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
entries.last_summary: Amazon has reportedly acquired Decart’s AI optimization team and technology for $7.5 billion, likely to enhance its internal Trainium chip development.

entries.title: Meta throws out its net-zero goal — its competitors should be furious
entries.last_summary: Meta has officially abandoned its 2030 net-zero sustainability target in its 2026 report, sparking criticism regarding the tech industry's climate commitments.

entries.title: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
entries.last_summary: Sierra, a startup focused on AI for customer experience, has reached a $30 billion valuation after a $1.75 billion Series F funding round.

entries.title: Teaching with AI
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has published a guide for educators on integrating ChatGPT into classrooms, offering advice on prompts and AI limitations. The release aims to address common concerns regarding academic integrity and AI bias.

entries.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
entries.last_summary: New testing suggests that GPT-6 models possess intrinsic capabilities for protein structure design and sequence generation. Laboratory results indicate successful binding across five tested targets.

entries.title: Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT
entries.last_summary: Clay has integrated GPT-6 models into its sales software to automate go-to-market research and data analysis. The tool aims to help sales teams better convert data into actionable revenue strategies.

entries.title: The Download: AI’s gas power boom and a consciousness reality check
entries.last_summary: Data center developers facing decade-long waits for grid connections are building behind-the-meter, off-grid natural gas plants to support AI capacity needs.

entries.title: Why using rocks for carbon removal could eventually reduce crop growth
entries.last_summary: New concerns are emerging regarding the environmental trade-offs of enhanced rock weathering for carbon removal. Research suggests that spreading crushed minerals like basalt could potentially impact soil health and crop yields.

entries.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
entries.last_summary: A new benchmark indicates that current leading AI agents often fail to perform everyday tasks reliably and safely. These findings underscore the persistent gap between model capabilities and real-world autonomy.

entries.title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
entries.last_summary: Startup Maple has raised $5.3 million to develop encrypted AI architectures designed to keep user data private from the provider itself. The technology focuses on secure processing to protect sensitive enterprise information.

entries.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
entries.last_summary: Anthropic’s stock has fallen below its IPO price, raising concerns about cooling market sentiment toward high-valuation AI startups. Investors are monitoring the slump for signs of a broader valuation reset in the sector.

entries.title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
entries.last_summary: Meta has integrated its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram Direct Messages. This update removes the friction of switching between apps to access the company's AI tools.

entries.title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
entries.last_summary: Tidal plans to remove millions of AI-generated tracks from its platform to combat the influx of AI slop. The streaming service will continue to permit tracks created with AI assistance, but will block fully generative content.
